visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fair-skinned young woman with light brown hair styled in a side braid peers into a brown paper bag from above. She has large eyes, wears light makeup, and is dressed in a light blue collared shirt with a blue-and-white striped bow. The background is a bright, soft-lit indoor setting with white slatted doors. (2) A hand holds a bright yellow sticky note inside the brown bag with the words "Moody x Snoopy" written in black ink. (3) The scene shifts to a wide shot of the woman sitting cross-legged on a white carpet next to a white sofa. She is smiling and looking at a collection of Snoopy-branded boxes and bags spread out in front of her. (4) The camera cuts to a medium close-up as she holds two small Snoopy-shaped hair clips. She proceeds to clip one onto her hair and shows a matching Snoopy hair tie on her braid, smiling warmly at the camera. (5) She unboxes a square white box featuring a Snoopy illustration, revealing a circular tin and a glass jar filled with small, yellow, star-shaped soaps. She brings the products close to the camera for detail. (6) She holds a blue pack of makeup remover wipes, showing both the front and back of the packaging before demonstrating a single white wipe. (7) She presents a tube of mascara remover and applies the wand to her eyelashes in a gentle upward motion. (8) Two small, cylindrical blue and white bottles are shown; she taps one against her fringe to demonstrate the hair powder. (9) She showcases a grey mesh pouch with a Snoopy design, followed by a white quilted bag which she briefly rests her head on like a pillow. (10) She opens a larger cream-colored corduroy bag, showing the interior pockets and zippers before smiling and waving as the brand logo appears on a white screen.
